A '''scout troop''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A troop was comprised of four [[scout platoon]]s, along with command and support elements. The troop numbers one hundred and sixteen [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] and forty [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]. The command element traveled in a [[LAVr QH-7 Chariot/Legends|command speeder]], and the support element was also mobile.<ref name="ISB" />

A scout troop could be augmented by the addition of four more scout platoons.<ref name="ISB2" />
